descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-13 ER 1-2; TFA-92591 AC 1, AC 6 · “Paste and photo are physician-triggered only; nothing happens automatically”. Mixed: stated part — Extraction only on Save & Extract with the pasted or read text; background, imaging and issue reach the chart; a failed extraction shows an explicit error (3.5); our part — The note kept through a reload and the extraction re-run only on a tap (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S01 Existing specs (mocked AI): Save & Extract is the only trigger; review, delete and retry on tap; Nursing Home save and delete

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Paste and photograph are physician-triggered only. Nothing is read, extracted or written to the chart until the physician pastes or photographs a prior note and saves it, and no prior note is pulled … (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 6; TFA-92591 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U2 From an explicitly pasted or photographed prior note, the background, active issues, imaging and diagnostic tests are extracted correctly and update that patient's chart. (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 1; TFA-92591 How it works 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's fixtures: a Hospital patient with a manual Important Point, one lab and one imaging finding, plus a Nursing Home resident. Photo read and extraction are mocked at the Convex socket

When Hospital: paste a prior note dated Sep 14 and press Save & Extract. Photograph → review → Save & Extract → collapse → expand → delete. Make a first extraction fail, then reload → expand → Extract Fields. Nursing Home: Paste → date → Save Note → delete

Then No extraction call before Save & Extract, and exactly one after, carrying the pasted or read text. Background reaches Hospital Course, imaging reaches Diagnostic Testing, the issue reaches the chart, and the manual point is kept. Read text waits in the box for review. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in the four tests; the scenario passes only if all four pass. U1: extraction.calls has length 0 before the click and 1 after, with priorNoteText equal to the pasted or read note; retry happens only on Extract Fields. U2: panel wiring only, with a mocked model. The prior lab is stored as an undated row and U4 is not checked. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
